# Working agreements

Keep the delivery interface small. Never log signing secrets. Do not retry client errors. All changes must include a rationale and disclose checks that were not run.

<!-- braid:instructions:start -->
## Instructions from Braid

- Never log webhook secrets. Blocked in `src/**`: `console.log(secret`.
- No em dashes in UI copy. Blocked in `public/**`: `—`.
- Retries back off; never retry 4xx except 429. Applies to `src/**`.
<!-- braid:instructions:end -->

files.README.md:
# Relay · a tiny webhook service

A Workers-native webhook delivery example.

## Delivery

POST an event to a configured HTTPS endpoint.

## Receivers

Teams receiving Relay webhooks should read [the receiver contract](docs/receivers.md): how to verify signatures and drop duplicate deliveries.

## Retries

Relay retries 5xx and network errors up to three times with jittered backoff.
files.docs/receivers.md:
# Receiving Relay webhooks

Verify `x-relay-signature` with HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body. Deliveries may repeat; use `idempotency-key` to drop duplicates. Respond with 2xx within ten seconds.
files.public/status.html:
Relay status

Delivering webhooks
Retries
Up to three attempts with jittered backoff, for network errors, 429 and 5xx responses
Signatures
x-relay-signature, HMAC-SHA256 over the exact body
Timeouts
Ten seconds per endpoint unless it sets its own
Duplicates
Every attempt carries the same idempotency-key
